Yes — that's a proper "take my collection elsewhere" file. It's got all eight of my links with their titles, each carrying its saved date and its labels, gathered in a sensible way with an Archive section kept separate — the sort of file another browser would happily swallow. So if I ever wanted to move on, or just open my collection somewhere else, I'm not locked in; my bookmarks come with me.

And I appreciate that you're upfront that this browser-friendly file can't carry everything — things like my written notes or their formatting aren't part of that kind of file. That's honest, and it's exactly why having the separate "complete backup" option matters to me: one file for moving to another browser, and a fuller one that keeps my whole library — notes and all — safe. Let me check that complete backup does keep the lot, and then I think we've covered getting my stuff in and out.
